scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Hey~! Hi human~ This is Mr. Dolangmal. kakaka~
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
嘿~！人类，你好呀~
我就是多朗马尔先生，嘎嘎嘎~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
We are sent to here to take you to the heaven of cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
我们被派到这里，是为了带你去猫的天堂——^A2314B绵绵岛^000000。

scripts.text: [Dolangmal]
scripts.translation: [多朗马尔]

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Why don't you go to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?The smell of this sea place is better than Mora, which is full of a grassy smell.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
要不要去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000？这里有海洋的气息，比满是青草味的穆拉好多了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Why don't you go to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?The safe place is better than Lighthalzen, which is too dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
要不要去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000？这里安全多了，比危险的里希塔乐镇强。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Why don't you go to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?The complex place is better than Rachel, where it's too horribly quiet.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
要不要去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000？这里热闹多了，比安静得吓人的拉赫好。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Why don't you go to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?The beautiful place is better than Juno, which is full of books and headaches.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
要不要去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000？这里风景优美，比满是书本、让人头疼的朱诺好多了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Why don't you go to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?The beautiful and quiet place is better than Morocc, with its heat and sandstorms.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
要不要去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000？这里美丽又宁静，比又热又常有沙尘暴的梦罗克好多了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Why don't you go to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?The beautiful and quiet place is better than Aldebaran, where it's so noisy with the tick-tock sound of the clock.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
要不要去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000？这里美丽又宁静，比整天滴答作响、吵闹不休的艾尔帕兰好多了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
The fresh air of Payon is not bad, but why don't you go better place like the heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
斐扬的空气固然清新，但要不要去更好的地方——猫的天堂^A2314B绵绵岛^000000看看？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Why don't you go to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000? That place is better than Geffen, where there are only crowds of simple honest wizards.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
要不要去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000看看？
那儿可比吉芬好多了，吉芬满大街都是老实巴交的巫师。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
How is that? The crowded city of Prontera is good, but why don't you go our heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
怎么样？人来人往的普隆德拉固然不错，但要不要去我们猫的天堂——^A2314B绵绵岛^000000看看？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text: ^A2314BMalangdo^000000~ Go~ Go~

[Dolangmal]
What!? You don't want to go ^A2314BMalangdo^000000? Chet!
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
什么！？你不想去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000？
切！

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
You're such an annoying guy. If you don't go, why did you talk to me... but...
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
你这家伙真麻烦。
不想去还来搭什么话...不过...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 said to kidnap humans... No... Bring them politely?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
^9E1837托马斯提督^000000说要把人类绑架过去...不对...是礼貌地请过去？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Anyway, I got you. Whenever you want to go, just tell me.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
行吧，我知道了。
想去的时候，随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ok! I like your attitude. Full of passion.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
好！就喜欢你这股热情劲儿！

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Now, before you go ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, let me give you some warnings.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
那么，在你去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000之前，我先给你几点忠告。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
First!! It is natural that when you arrive on ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, you should notify ^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 that you are here.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
第一！！到了^A2314B绵绵岛^000000，当然得先找^9E1837托马斯提督^000000报到。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
If you don't do that, you might be attacked by scary and wild cats when you walk through dark streets.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
如果不这么做，你走在黑暗的街道上时，可能会被凶猛可怕的野猫袭击。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Secondly!! This ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 is absolutely our island of cats, even though we open to humans.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
第二！！虽然^A2314B绵绵岛^000000对人类开放，但这里终究是我们猫的岛屿。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
We have a personality... no... no... respect us like one catality because we are cats.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
我们也是有人格的...不对，不对...我们是猫，请尊重我们的“猫格”！

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
And the next one is...
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
然后下一条是...

scripts.text: Dolangmal proceeds and gives hundreds of warnings.
scripts.translation: 多朗马尔滔滔不绝地讲了几百条忠告。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ok! Those are all the warnings!! They're easy and simple... right? Can you remember them?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
好！忠告就这些！！
都很简单明了...对吧？
记住了吗？

scripts.text: Remember his warnings
scripts.translation: 记住他的忠告

scripts.text: Can't remember
scripts.translation: 记不住

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ok! Do not bite two mice with one mouth. ^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 is located at the ^A2314Bcenter of the ship in Malangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
好！可别一张嘴咬两只老鼠，说话不算话哦。
^9E1837托马斯提督^000000就在^A2314B绵绵岛的船中央^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Don't forget to give him notice of your arrival.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
别忘了向他报到。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Alright. Let's go to the heaven of the cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000~
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
好了。我们去猫的天堂——^A2314B绵绵岛^000000吧~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
What!? Can't you keep these easy rules? Chet!
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
什么！？这么简单的规矩都守不住？
切！

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
You're such an annoying guy. If you can't keep these, why didn't you tell me during our conversation? I told you everything... but..
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
你这家伙真麻烦。
守不住规矩，刚才怎么不早说？
害我全讲完了...不过...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
^9E1837Admiral Tomas^000000 said to kidnap humans... No... Bring them politely?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
^9E1837托马斯提督^000000说要把人类绑架过去...不对...是礼貌地请过去？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Anyway, I got you. Just tell me whenever you want to go.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
行吧，我知道了。
想去的时候，随时告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Uh? You must be the one from last time...? Alright. Did you visit ^A2314BMalangdo^000000?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
咦？你是上次那个人...？
对了，你去过^A2314B绵绵岛^000000了吗？

scripts.text: Take me to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 again
scripts.translation: 再带我去一次^A2314B绵绵岛^000000

scripts.text: I have visited
scripts.translation: 我去过了

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
I really want to send you there, but I can't because of the policy. It is difficult to send people who have visited ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 already.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
我也想送你去，可规定不允许。
已经去过^A2314B绵绵岛^000000的人，我不能再送了。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
And that was roughly it... It's supposed to be rule 53...
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
大概就是这么回事...应该是第53条规定...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Actually, let me tell you rule 53. I am an indulgent cat.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
好吧，我就告诉你第53条。
谁让我是一只宽宏大量的猫呢。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
If you want to go back to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, take the ship at Izlude or Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
如果你想再去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000，就到依斯鲁得岛或艾尔贝塔坐船。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
If you enjoy that pleasant sea trip, you will arrive at the heaven of cats, ^A2314BMalangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
享受一段愉快的海上旅程，你就会抵达猫的天堂——^A2314B绵绵岛^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
So easy! Isn't it? Well, good bye~
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
很简单吧？那么，再见~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
How was it? You liked it? I knew it. Kakaka~
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
怎么样？喜欢吧？
我就知道，嘎嘎嘎~

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Ah! I just want to make sure...
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
啊！我再确认一下...

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Again, if you want to go back to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, do you know where to take a ship at Izlude or Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
再确认一次，要回^A2314B绵绵岛^000000的话，你知道去依斯鲁得或艾尔贝塔哪里坐船吧？

scripts.text:
[Dolangmal]
Hm~ You might know because you're a smart person. Well, see you again~
scripts.translation:
[多朗马尔]
嗯~你这么聪明，肯定知道。
那下次见啦~

scripts.text: This cat is sleeping in the warm Alberta sun.
scripts.translation: 这只猫正在温暖的艾尔贝塔阳光下睡觉。

scripts.text: This cat is sleeping in the warm Izlude sun.
scripts.translation: 这只猫正在温暖的依斯鲁得岛阳光下睡觉。

scripts.text: Let him sleep
scripts.translation: 让它睡吧

scripts.text: Talk to him
scripts.translation: 跟它说话

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Meow? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
喵？嗯？

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
You are a hero of cat's fleet. Your activity is the legend between us.
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
您可是猫舰队的英雄，您的事迹在我们当中都成了传说。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
As you are a hero of the cat fleet let me send you to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 for free.
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
您是猫舰队的英雄，我就免费送您去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000吧。

scripts.text: Send me to Malangdo!
scripts.translation: 送我去绵绵岛！

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Have a comfortable trip... Alright let's go~
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
祝您一路舒舒服服的...好，出发~

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Huh! You are so annoying. Let me send you to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000 for ^0000FF1000 Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
哼！你真烦人。送你去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000只要^0000FF1000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
You have a little relationship with fleet of cat. I'll give you special discount price ^0000FF999 Zeny^000000 to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000, because you have relationship with fleet.
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
您和猫舰队有些交情。我给您特别优惠价^0000FF999 Zeny^000000，送您去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
You gave several help to our cat's fleet so let me give you special that with 50% discount price ^0000FF500 Zeny^000000. I'll send you to ^A2314BMalangdo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
您帮过猫舰队好几次，我就给您五折优惠，只要^0000FF500 Zeny^000000，送您去^A2314B绵绵岛^000000。

scripts.text: Send me to Malangdo!
scripts.translation: 送我去绵绵岛！

scripts.text: Do not go.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Money? Where is the money? You can't go anywhere without the money. Shame on you.
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
钱呢？钱在哪儿？
没钱可哪儿都去不了，真不像话。

scripts.text:
[Odgnalam]
Let me send you right away. Let's go~
scripts.translation:
[奥德格纳拉姆]
这就送您过去，出发~

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Did you have fun in Malangdo?
The fleet has a service to Izlude and Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
您在绵绵岛玩得开心吗？
我们船队有开往依斯鲁得岛和艾尔贝塔的航线。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
The fee of ship is only 1000 zeny, where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
船费只需1000 Zeny，您想去哪里？

scripts.text:
[Kong]
You have a connection with our fleet. Apply special price 999 zeny. Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
您和我们船队有交情，就算您特价999 Zeny。
您想去哪儿？

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Wow~ You contributed to our fleet a lot. Alright!! Special discount price 500 zeny. Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
哇~您为我们船队出了不少力！
好，就给您特别优惠价500 Zeny！
您想去哪儿？

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Ah... You are the legendary hero of our cat's fleet.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
啊...您就是我们猫舰队的传奇英雄。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
We can't charge the hero of our fleet. What is your destination?
scripts.translation:
[孔]
哪能收我们船队英雄的钱呢。
您想去哪儿？

scripts.text: - Izlude destination --- 1000 zeny
scripts.translation: - 前往依斯鲁得岛 --- 1000 Zeny

scripts.text: - Alberta destination --- 1000 zeny
scripts.translation: - 前往艾尔贝塔 --- 1000 Zeny

scripts.text: - Stay on Malangdo
scripts.translation: - 留在绵绵岛

scripts.text: - Izlude destination --- 999 zeny
scripts.translation: - 前往依斯鲁得岛 --- 999 Zeny

scripts.text: - Alberta destination --- 999 zeny
scripts.translation: - 前往艾尔贝塔 --- 999 Zeny

scripts.text: - Izlude destination --- 500 zeny
scripts.translation: - 前往依斯鲁得岛 --- 500 Zeny

scripts.text: - Alberta destination --- 500 zeny
scripts.translation: - 前往艾尔贝塔 --- 500 Zeny

scripts.text: - Izlude destination --- Free for the hero of our fleet!!
scripts.translation: - 前往依斯鲁得岛 --- 猫舰队英雄免费乘坐！！

scripts.text: - Alberta destination --- Free for the hero of our fleet!!
scripts.translation: - 前往艾尔贝塔 --- 猫舰队英雄免费乘坐！！

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Have a nice day in Malangdo.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
祝您在绵绵岛度过愉快的一天。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Have a full of fortune day in Malangdo...
scripts.translation:
[孔]
祝您在绵绵岛度过满载好运的一天...

scripts.text:
[Kong]
There are full of fortune and jackpot in Malangdo.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
绵绵岛遍地好运，还有机会中大奖。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
It is difficult for free.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
免费可不容易啊。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
No one objects to the hero of our fleet staying in Malangdo...
scripts.translation:
[孔]
猫舰队的英雄想在绵绵岛多住些日子，当然没人会反对...

scripts.text:
[Kong]
It is difficult even though you have a relationship with the fleet.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
就算和舰队有交情，也很难免费乘船。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Have a comfortable trip.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
祝您旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Oh my god. You don't have 500 zeny? It is difficult for free.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
天哪，您连500 Zeny都没有吗？免费可不容易啊。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
{0}

[Kong]
Have a nice trip.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
祝您旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Thanks, have a wonderful trip.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
谢谢，祝您一路顺风。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
Have a nice trip and come again.
scripts.translation:
[孔]
旅途愉快，欢迎再来。

scripts.text:
[Kong]
{0}

You see a lazy cat standing on a chair.
You guess that this is the Innkeeper.
scripts.translation:
你看到一只懒洋洋的猫站在椅子上。
你猜它就是旅店老板。

scripts.text: Umm... Can I rest here?
scripts.translation: 嗯...我可以在这里休息吗？

scripts.text: Psst... Can I save here?
scripts.translation: 嘘...我可以在这里存档吗？

scripts.text: Leave.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Eh?
Uh, sure you can use this hammock if you give me ^FF00005 Malangdo Cans^000000.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
嗯？
呃，给我^FF00005个绵绵岛风味罐头^000000，这张吊床就让你用。

scripts.text: Here you go.
scripts.translation: 给你

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Now relax.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
好好放松吧。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
This ain't no charity.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
我这可不是做慈善的。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Let me know if you want to relax.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
如果你想放松，告诉我一声。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Location saved. We should keep company, haha~
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
存档完成。以后常来往啊，哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Sometimes you just have to relax.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
有时候就是得放松一下。

scripts.text: - Wow, this is the laziest cat ever. -
scripts.translation: - 哇，真没见过这么懒的猫。 -

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Boy, that lazy cat makes me want to just nap all day long.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
哎呀，看着那只懒猫，我也只想整天睡大觉。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
He makes life look so simple.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
看它这样，日子过得可真简单。

scripts.text:
[Wanderer]
The cats living in here are so energetic.
Is it weird that they make me want to dance all day?
La di dah di dah~!
scripts.translation:
[浪姬舞者]
住在这里的猫都好有活力。
看着它们就想跳上一整天，我是不是有点奇怪？
啦哩哒哩哒~！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Ooo~ their soft puffy tails and soft fur~
I can't stand it, this is heaven~~!!
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
噢~蓬松柔软的尾巴，软乎乎的毛~
受不了了，这里简直是天堂~~！！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
My hidden card, ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000, can make all cats in Malangdo my slaves~ haha!
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
我的王牌——^FF0000猕猴桃果实^000000，能让绵绵岛所有的猫都成为我的奴隶~哈哈！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000?

[Cat Trainer]
It is such a rare item!
I can barely get it.
But these cudly cats can't resist it~
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
那可是非常稀有的东西！
我也很难弄到。
但这些可爱的猫咪对它毫无抵抗力~

scripts.text: Where can I get ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000?
scripts.translation: 哪里能弄到^FF0000猕猴桃果实^000000？

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Why would I tell you when I can barely get it?
I wouldn't even tell you for all the zeny in the world~!
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
我本来就很难弄到，为什么要告诉你？
就算给我全世界的Zeny我也不会说~！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
All the Malangdo cats are mine~!
Muahahahaha~
With enough ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000 I can be a queen in Malangdo~ ohhhh!!!
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
绵绵岛所有的猫都是我的~！
哇哈哈哈哈~
只要有足够的^FF0000猕猴桃果实^000000，我就能成为绵绵岛的女王~噢噢噢！！！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Ooo~ their soft puffy tails and soft fur~
I can't stand it, this is heaven~~!!
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
噢~蓬松柔软的尾巴，软乎乎的毛~
受不了了，这里简直是天堂~~！！

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
This is my little secret called
^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000. I can use
it to make the Malangdo cats my
slaves~ muahahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
我的小秘密，就叫^FF0000猕猴桃果实^000000。
有了它，绵绵岛的猫都会乖乖当我的奴隶~哇哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text: ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000?

[Cat Trainer]
Hmm, I guess it's no wonder you don't know.
These Malangdo cats can't resist it.
But it's too rare of an item to get so you shouldn't bother trying to find it.
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
嗯，你不知道也不奇怪。
绵绵岛的猫对它毫无抵抗力。
不过它太稀有了，你还是别费劲去找了。

scripts.text: Where can I get ^FF0000Silvervine Fruit^000000?
scripts.translation: 哪里能弄到^FF0000猕猴桃果实^000000？

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Actually, it's simple. You just...
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
其实很简单，你只要...

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
Hey, you almost made me tell my secret.
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
嘿，你差点让我把秘密说漏嘴了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Trainer]
One day these cats will be mine.
I can be a king in Malangdo~ ohhh~!
scripts.translation:
[驯猫师]
总有一天，这些猫都会是我的。
我就能当上绵绵岛的国王啦~噢噢~！
